title: Are the sim's loudness inputs true to real parts and real rooms?

criteria.claim: The sim's 28 mm speaker is as loud as real 28 mm, 8 ohm, 1 W parts (dB SPL at 10 cm with 1 W).
criteria.source: Distributor listings, 2026-10-18: Taoglas SPKM.28.8.A 89 dB at 0.5 W / 10 cm (= 92 dB at 1 W); PUI Audio AS02808MR-R 80 dB at 1 W / 1 m (= 100 dB at 10 cm). Confirm in the PDF datasheets.

criteria.claim: The amp's power on battery voltage matches the MAX98357A's published figures into 8 ohms.
criteria.source: Adafruit MAX98357 guide: 0.8 W at 3.3 V and 1.8 W at 5 V into 8 ohms, 10% THD. 3.7 V lies between; 1.0 W is an interpolation, not a datasheet value.

criteria.claim: The sound lost through the shell (pink noise, A-weighted) matches a phone measurement of a real speaker wrapped in real foam.
criteria.procedure: See docs/MEASURING.md, test 2: pink noise from a small speaker, phone meter 30 cm away, open air then wrapped in foam; record open-air LAeq minus wrapped LAeq.

criteria.claim: The sim's Christmas-morning background (58 dBA) matches a real lively family room.
criteria.procedure: See docs/MEASURING.md, test 1: phone meter on the table during a lively family moment, 60-second LAeq.
